name: audara-studio
description: audara-studio: make videos from code, and their soundtracks, in Claude Code and Codex, starting from an idea or from nothing.

plugins.name: audara-studio
plugins.description: Make videos from code (WebGL/GLSL, three.js, Canvas2D) with a live preview and an MP4 render, plus song- or script-to-soundtrack timing, help choosing what to make, a git repository others can clone and render, a finished video's YouTube thumbnails, title, description and tags, and the Nutlight house style for explainers.
